facts.fact: Jerónimos Monastery is a sixteenth-century monument in Belém.
It was classified as UNESCO World Heritage in 1983.
The church contains the tombs of Vasco da Gama and Luís de Camões.

title: Visit Lisboa — Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
